answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities: each identity files a receipt on the basalt plate for 50 and locks a 70 bond. A pearl seal binds one key per receipt; a rented one names its lender. A zephyr sweep replays a tenth of receipts each epoch; a fake or rented one burns the bond, voids the identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 1,000x50=50,000 each epoch, 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool: net loss 10,000. An honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its share.
